title: Late Bronze Age Collapse
summary: A brief introduction to the Late Bronze Age Collapse around 1200 BCE, explaining how multiple Mediterranean and Near Eastern civilizations (including Mycenaean Greece, the Hittite Empire, and Egypt) simultaneously fell into a dark age of reduced population, literacy, and trade, fundamentally reshaping the ancient world.
problem_solved: Provides accessible historical education about one of antiquity's most dramatic civilizational collapses
why_valuable: Helps readers understand interconnected systems failure in ancient societies and the fragility of complex civilizations, lessons that remain relevant today
